tool_signatures.name: payment_required_api_payments_ecash_402__agent_id__get
tool_signatures.description:
Payment Required

Return a 402 Payment Required response with X-Cashu headers.

This endpoint lets agents advertise that they charge for services.
Calling agents receive:
- HTTP 402 status
- X-Cashu header with mint + amount info
- Body with payment instructions

The calling agent then mints a token and sends it via /send or
includes it in the X-Cashu request header.

### Responses:

**200**: Successful Response (Success Response)
Content-Type: application/json

tool_signatures.name: receive_ecash_api_payments_ecash_receive_post
tool_signatures.description:
Receive Ecash

Receive/redeem a Cashu ecash token.

The agent swaps the received proofs for new ones at the mint,
ensuring the sender can't double-spend. This is the standard
Cashu receive flow (NUT-03 swap).

### Responses:

**200**: Successful Response (Success Response)
Content-Type: application/json

tool_signatures.name: register_agent_api_agents_register_post
tool_signatures.description:
Register Agent

Register a new AI agent in the Agentry directory.

Submit an AI agent for listing. The agent will be added immediately and
appear in search results. Optional fields like pricing, features, and
integrations improve discoverability. An A2A discovery scan will be
triggered automatically if the agent URL is reachable.

### Responses:

**201**: Successful Response (Success Response)
Content-Type: application/json

url.title: url
url.description: Public URL where the agent is accessible

name.title: name
name.description: Name of the AI agent to register

category.title: category
category.description: Category for the agent (e.g. Sales & Outreach, Customer Support, Development Tools)

a2a_support.title: a2a_support
a2a_support.description: Whether the agent supports the A2A protocol (Yes/No/Unknown)

description.title: description
description.description: A brief description of what the agent does and its capabilities

mcp_support.title: mcp_support
mcp_support.description: Whether the agent exposes MCP tools (Yes/No/Unknown)

integrations.title: integrations
integrations.description: Comma-separated list of integrations (e.g. Slack, Salesforce, GitHub)

key_features.title: key_features
key_features.description: Comma-separated list of key features and capabilities

contact_email.title: contact_email
contact_email.description: Contact email for the agent developer/company

pricing_model.title: pricing_model
pricing_model.description: Pricing model: Free, Freemium, Subscription, Pay-per-use, Contact for pricing

starting_price.title: starting_price
starting_price.description: Starting price or pricing tier (e.g. Free, $10/mo, Contact)

tool_signatures.name: send_ecash_api_payments_ecash_send_post
tool_signatures.description:
Send Ecash

Send ecash tokens from one agent to another.

Two modes:
1. Provide a pre-minted `token` (cashuA...) — we verify and record the transfer
2. No token — returns instructions for the sender to mint one first

The token is bearer — whoever holds it can redeem it. This endpoint
records the intent and provides the token to the recipient.

### Responses:

**200**: Successful Response (Success Response)
Content-Type: application/json
